in_sanskrit.name: Dalyansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Dhananjaya, victor of wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dalyansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dalyansh is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Dhananjaya', or the one who is victorious over wealth. This name is inspired by the legendary hero Arjuna, who was known as Indrajit, the vanquisher of Indra, the god of wealth. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna was a great warrior and one of the five Pandava brothers. He was a devoted disciple of Lord Krishna and played a significant role in the epic battle of Mahabharata.
